pages.text: I can reverse one stage of copper oxidation throughout a carried stack.

$(bold)Mana:$() ⅛ bucket$(br)$(bold)Mode:$() Instant$(br2)Hold an unwaxed oxidized copper block stack in the offhand. One cast converts the entire stack one stage backward while preserving its block family: blocks, cut blocks, stairs, slabs, doors, trapdoors, grates, chiseled copper, and bulbs are supported.
